Scripts._description: The **Scripts** library provides advanced functions for inspecting and interacting with script objects. It allows you to analyse bytecode, retrieve closures and environments, and simulate the loading or running of scripts.

getcallingscript.title: getcallingscript
getcallingscript.description: `getcallingscript` returns the [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), or [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript) that **triggered the current code execution**.

getloadedmodules.title: getloadedmodules
getloadedmodules.description: `getloadedmodules` returns a list of all [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript) objects that have been **loaded** (e.g. [`require`'d](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/globals/LuaGlobals#require)).

getrunningscripts.title: getrunningscripts
getrunningscripts.description: `getrunningscripts` returns a list of **all running scripts** in the caller's global state. This includes [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), and [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript) objects - excluding [`CoreScripts`](https://robloxapi.github.io/ref/class/CoreScript.html) by default.

getscripthash.title: getscripthash
getscripthash.description: `getscripthash` returns a [SHA-384 hash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-3) in ***hexadecimal format*** of the raw bytecode for a given [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), or [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript).
getscripthash.signature: function getscripthash(script: BaseScript | ModuleScript): string | nil

parameters.script: The script object to retrieve the bytecode from.

getscriptbytecode.title: getscriptbytecode
getscriptbytecode.description: `getscriptbytecode` retrieves the bytecode of a [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript), and [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script).
getscriptbytecode.signature: function getscriptbytecode(script: BaseScript | ModuleScript): string | nil

parameters.script: The script object to convert into a function.

getscriptclosure.title: getscriptclosure
getscriptclosure.description: `getscriptclosure` creates and returns a Luau **function closure** from the compiled bytecode of a [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), or [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript).

parameters.thread: The Luau thread whose associated script should be retrieved.

getscriptfromthread.title: getscriptfromthread
getscriptfromthread.description: `getscriptfromthread` returns the [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), or [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript) associated with a given [Luau thread](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/libraries/coroutine#running).
getscriptfromthread.signature: function getscriptfromthread(thread: thread): BaseScript | ModuleScript | nil

getscripts.title: getscripts
getscripts.description: `getscripts` returns a list of **all [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), and [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript) objects** present.

parameters.script: The script object whose environment should be retrieved.

getsenv.title: getsenv
getsenv.description: `getsenv` returns the **global environment table** of a given [`Script`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Script), [`LocalScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/LocalScript), or [`ModuleScript`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ModuleScript).
getsenv.signature: function getsenv(script: BaseScript | ModuleScript): { [any]: any } | nil

Metatable._description:
The **Metatable** library enables advanced interaction with [metatables](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/metatables) in Luau. It provides direct access to core metamethods and internal table behaviours - including those normally protected or hidden via `__metatable` locks.
This library is especially useful when trying to modify or access hidden things within locked Roblox objects.

parameters.object: The object whose metatable to retrieve.

getrawmetatable.title: getrawmetatable
getrawmetatable.description: `getrawmetatable` returns the raw metatable of an object, even if that object has a `__metatable` field set.
getrawmetatable.signature: function getrawmetatable(object: { any } | userdata): { [any]: any } | nil

parameters.table: The table to check for readonly status.

isreadonly.title: isreadonly
isreadonly.description: `isreadonly` checks whether a table is currently set as **readonly**.

getnamecallmethod.title: getnamecallmethod
getnamecallmethod.description: `getnamecallmethod` returns the name of the method that invoked the [`__namecall`](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/how-do-i-get-namecall-method/2848439/5) metamethod.

parameters.object: The value whose metatable will be overwritten.

setrawmetatable.title: setrawmetatable
setrawmetatable.description: `setrawmetatable` forcibly sets the metatable of a value, bypassing the `__metatable` protection field.
setrawmetatable.signature: function setrawmetatable<T>(object: T & ({ any } | userdata), metatable: { any }): T

parameters.table: The table whose readonly status you want to modify.
parameters.state: `true` to lock the table, `false` to unlock it.

setreadonly.title: setreadonly
setreadonly.description: `setreadonly` sets whether a table is **readonly** or **writable**.

getrenv.title: getrenv
getrenv.description: `getrenv` returns the **Roblox global environment**, which is used by the entire game. Changes to this environment will affect your executor environment as well.

Environment._description: The **Environment** library allows access and inspection to our and Roblox's environment.

parameters.includeTables?: If `true`, also includes tables in the returned list. Defaults to `false`.

getgc.title: getgc
getgc.description: `getgc` returns a list of **non-dead garbage-collectable values**. These include functions, userdatas, and optionally tables.

getgenv.title: getgenv
getgenv.description: `getgenv` returns the **executor's global environment table**, which is shared across all executor-made threads.

parameters.filterType: The type of value to search for.
parameters.returnOne?: If `true`, returns the first match, instead of a table of matches.
parameters.filterOptions: A set of rules used to match functions or tables. [See below.](#filter-option-types)

filtergc.title: filtergc
filtergc.description: `filtergc` allows you to retrieve specific garbage-collected values from Luau's memory, using fine-tuned filters.
filtergc.signature:
export type AnyFunction = (...any) -> (...any)
export type AnyTable = { [any]: any }
declare filtergc: 
    (( filterType: "function", filterOptions: FunctionFilterOptions, returnOne: true) -> AnyFunction? ) &
    ((( filterType: "function", filterOptions: FunctionFilterOptions, returnOne: false?) -> ( AnyFunction | { AnyFunction } ) )) &
    (( filterType: "table", filterOptions: TableFilterOptions, returnOne: true) -> { AnyTable? } ) &
    (( filterType: "table", filterOptions: TableFilterOptions, returnOne: false? ) -> { AnyTable })

getreg.title: getreg
getreg.description: `getreg` returns the **Luau registry table**. The registry is a special table which is used internally to store references like threads, functions, and data shared between C and Luau (userdata).

WebSocket._description: The `WebSocket` class provides a lightweight interface for establishing and working with WebSocket connections. It allows scripts to **send** and **receive** messages over a persistent connection to a [WebSocket](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WebSocket) server.

cleardrawcache.title: cleardrawcache
cleardrawcache.description: `cleardrawcache` removes **all active drawing objects** created with [`Drawing.new`](https://docs.sunc.io/Drawing/#constructor).

Drawing._description:
The `Drawing` class represents a renderable 2D object that appears on the user's screen. Every specific drawing type (e.g. `Circle`, `Text`, `Line`) inherits from this base and extends it with shape-specific properties.
Drawing objects are ***not*** instances or engine objects - they are client-only graphical primitives defined by the implementation that do not interact with the 3D world and must be managed manually.

parameters.property: The name of the property to retrieve.

getrenderproperty.title: getrenderproperty
getrenderproperty.description: `getrenderproperty` retrieves the value of a property from a [`Drawing`](https://docs.sunc.io/Drawing/) object. This behaves identically to using `object[property]`, but is useful when working with dynamic property names or for reflection-like access.
getrenderproperty.signature: function getrenderproperty(drawing: Drawing, property: string): any

parameters.object: The value to check for Drawing validity.

isrenderobj.title: isrenderobj
isrenderobj.description: `isrenderobj` checks whether a given value is a valid [`Drawing`](https://docs.sunc.io/Drawing/) object.

parameters.property: The name of the property to assign.
parameters.value: The value to assign to the specified property.

setrenderproperty.title: setrenderproperty
setrenderproperty.description: `setrenderproperty` assigns a value to a property of a [`Drawing`](https://docs.sunc.io/Drawing/) object. This behaves identically to `object[property] = value`, but is useful for dynamic or abstracted property access.
setrenderproperty.signature: function setrenderproperty(drawing: Drawing, property: string, value: any): ()

parameters.path: The file path to read from.

readfile.title: readfile
readfile.description: `readfile` retrieves the contents of a file at the specified path and returns it as a string.

Filesystem._description:
The **Filesystem** library provides access to an executor's virtual file system. It enables reading, writing, creating, and deleting files and folders, as well as utility functions for interacting with content assets.
This library is especially useful when storing persistent data, managing resources across sessions, or loading runtime content dynamically.

isfolder.title: isfolder
isfolder.description: `isfolder` checks whether a given path exists and refers to a folder.

parameters.data: The string data to write into the file.
parameters.path: The file path to write to.

writefile.title: writefile
writefile.description: `writefile` writes data to a file at the specified path. If the file already exists, its contents will be overwritten.

parameters.path: The path to the directory to scan.

listfiles.title: listfiles
listfiles.description: `listfiles` returns an array of strings representing all files and folders within the specified directory.

parameters.path: The path of the folder to delete.

delfolder.title: delfolder
delfolder.description: `delfolder` deletes the folder at the specified path if it exists.

parameters.path: The path of the file to delete.

delfile.title: delfile
delfile.description: `delfile` deletes the file at the specified path if it exists.

parameters.path: The path to the file to be loaded.

loadfile.title: loadfile
loadfile.description: `loadfile` compiles the Luau source code from a file and returns the resulting function (chunk). This chunk runs in the global environment.
loadfile.signature: function loadfile<A...>(path: string): ((A...) -> any | nil, string?)

parameters.contents: The string content to add to the file.
parameters.path: The file path to append to.

appendfile.title: appendfile
appendfile.description: `appendfile` appends string content to the end of a file at the specified path. If the file does not exist, it will be created.

parameters.path: The file path to convert into an asset ID.

getcustomasset.title: getcustomasset
getcustomasset.description: `getcustomasset` returns a content ID (e.g. `rbxasset://`) that can be used in Roblox APIs for loading audio, meshes, UI images, and other asset types.

isfile.title: isfile
isfile.description: `isfile` checks whether a given path exists and refers to a file.

makefolder.title: makefolder
makefolder.description: `makefolder` creates a folder at the specified path if one does not already exist.

Instances._description:
The **Instances** library provides direct access to and manipulation of [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) objects in the game world. It includes tools for listing, referencing, and firing Roblox-native interactions.
These functions are especially useful for inspecting hidden instances, working with UI safely, or simulating player interactions with in-game objects.

parameters.object: The [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object) that owns the callback property.
parameters.property: The name of the callback property to retrieve.

getcallbackvalue.title: getcallbackvalue
getcallbackvalue.description: `getcallbackvalue` retrieves the **assigned callback property** on an [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object), such as [`OnInvoke`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/BindableFunction#OnInvoke).
getcallbackvalue.signature: function getcallbackvalue(object: Object, property: string): any | nil

parameters.distance?: Distance from which the click is simulated. Defaults to infinite.

fireclickdetector.title: fireclickdetector
fireclickdetector.description: `fireclickdetector` triggers a [`ClickDetector`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ClickDetector) event. By default, it fires the [`MouseClick`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ClickDetector#MouseClick) event.
fireclickdetector.signature: function fireclickdetector(detector: ClickDetector, distance: number?, event: string?): ()

parameters.toggle: Whether to simulate touch start or end. `true` or `0` simulates touch; `false` or `1` simulates un-touch.

firetouchinterest.title: firetouchinterest
firetouchinterest.description: `firetouchinterest` simulates a physical touch event between two [`BasePart`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/BasePart) objects. It can emulate both the start and end of a [`Touched`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/BasePart#Touched) event.
firetouchinterest.signature: function firetouchinterest(part1: BasePart, part2: BasePart, toggle: boolean | number): ()

compareinstances.title: compareinstances
compareinstances.signature: function compareinstances(object1: Instance, object2: Instance): boolean

fireproximityprompt.title: fireproximityprompt
fireproximityprompt.description: `fireproximityprompt` instantly triggers a [`ProximityPrompt`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ProximityPrompt), bypassing its [`HoldDuration`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ProximityPrompt#HoldDuration) and activation distance.

parameters.object: The [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) to clone a safe reference from.

cloneref.title: cloneref
cloneref.description: `cloneref` returns a **reference clone** of an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance). The returned object behaves identically to the original but is not strictly equal (`==`) to it.

gethui.title: gethui
gethui.description: `gethui` returns a **hidden [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance)** container used for safely storing UI elements. This container is mainly designed to **avoid detections**.

getinstances.title: getinstances
getinstances.description: `getinstances` retrieves **every [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance)** from the registry. Which means that instances that are/were parented to `nil` will also be returned.

getnilinstances.title: getnilinstances
getnilinstances.description: `getnilinstances` returns a list of [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) objects that are **currently unparented**. These instances exist in memory but are no longer part of the [`DataModel`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/DataModel) hierarchy.

parameters.index: The position of the constant to change.
parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) whose constant to modify.
parameters.value: The new constant value to set.

debug.setconstant.title: debug.setconstant
debug.setconstant.description: `debug.setconstant` modifies a constant at the specified index in a Luau function bytecode.
debug.setconstant.signature: function debug.setconstant(func: (...any) -> (...any) | number, index: number, value: number | string | boolean | nil): ()

parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) whose constant to retrieve.
parameters.index: The position of the desired constant.

debug.getconstant.title: debug.getconstant
debug.getconstant.description: `debug.getconstant` returns the constant at the specified index from a Luau function. If no constant exists at that index, it returns `nil` instead.
debug.getconstant.signature: function debug.getconstant(func: (...any) -> (...any) | number, index: number): number | string | boolean | nil

parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) to extract protos from.

debug.getprotos.title: debug.getprotos
debug.getprotos.description: `debug.getprotos` returns all function prototypes defined within the specified Luau function.

parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) to retrieve an upvalue from.

debug.getupvalue.title: debug.getupvalue
debug.getupvalue.description: `debug.getupvalue` returns the upvalue at the specified index from a Luau function's closure. If the index is invalid or out of bounds, an error will occur.
debug.getupvalue.signature: function debug.getupvalue(func: (...any) -> (...any) | number, index: number): any

parameters.index: The index/slot in the stack frame to replace.
parameters.value: The new value to assign at that stack slot.
parameters.level: The stack level to target. `1` refers to the current function.

debug.setstack.title: debug.setstack
debug.setstack.description: `debug.setstack` replaces a value in a specified stack frame.
debug.setstack.signature: function debug.setstack(level: number, index: number, value: any): ()

parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) to retrieve upvalues from.

debug.getupvalues.title: debug.getupvalues
debug.getupvalues.description: `debug.getupvalues` returns a list of upvalues captured by a Luau function. These are the external variables that a function closes over from its surrounding scope.

parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) whose constants will be returned.

debug.getconstants.title: debug.getconstants
debug.getconstants.description: `debug.getconstants` returns a list of all constants used within a Luau function's bytecode. This includes literal values like numbers, strings, booleans, and `nil`.
debug.getconstants.signature: function debug.getconstants(func: (...any) -> (...any) | number): { number | string | boolean | nil }

parameters.index: The index of the upvalue to be replaced.
parameters.func: The function (or stack level) whose upvalue to replace.
parameters.value: The new value to assign to the upvalue.

debug.setupvalue.title: debug.setupvalue
debug.setupvalue.description: `debug.setupvalue` replaces an upvalue at the specified index in a Luau function, with a new value.
debug.setupvalue.signature: function debug.setupvalue(func: (...any) -> (...any) | number, index: number, value: any): ()

parameters.index: The index of the prototype to return.
parameters.func: The Luau function (or stack level) to extract a proto from.
parameters.activated?: If `true`, returns a table of currently active functions based on the proto.

debug.getproto.title: debug.getproto
debug.getproto.description: `debug.getproto` returns a specific function prototype from a Luau function by index. Optionally, it can search for **active functions** of the proto, if the `activated` parameter is set to `true`.
debug.getproto.signature: function debug.getproto(func: (...any) -> (...any) | number, index: number, activated: boolean?): (...any) -> (...any) | { (...any) -> (...any) }

parameters.index?: The specific slot/index at that stack level to read.
parameters.level: The stack level to inspect. `1` is the current function.

debug.getstack.title: debug.getstack
debug.getstack.description: `debug.getstack` retrieves values from the stack at the specified call level.
debug.getstack.signature: function debug.getstack(level: number, index: number?): any | { any }

Debug._description:
The **Debug** library offers powerful tools for inspecting and modifying Luau functions at a bytecode level.
It allows you to access constants, upvalues, stack frames, and internal structures of functions that would otherwise be hidden - making it especially useful for reverse engineering and hooking.

Closures._description:
The **Closures** library enables the inspection, modification and creation of Luau closures with precise control.
It is one of the most powerful tools available, exposing internals in a way that Luau does not natively support out of the box.
This library is incredibly useful for hooking functions to modify game logic to your own advantage, and any other creative uses you can think of.

newcclosure.title: newcclosure
newcclosure.description: `newcclosure` takes any Luau function and wraps it into a C closure.

iscclosure.title: iscclosure
iscclosure.description: `iscclosure` checks whether a given function is a C closure or not.

parameters.object: The object which has a metatable.
parameters.metamethodName: The name of the metamethod to hook.
parameters.hook: The function that will be used as a hook.

hookmetamethod.title: hookmetamethod
hookmetamethod.description: `hookmetamethod` takes any Luau object that can have a metatable, and attempts to hook the specified metamethod of the object. Internally, it essentially uses [`hookfunction`](https://docs.sunc.io/Closures/hookfunction) to hook specific metamethods.
hookmetamethod.signature: function hookmetamethod(object: { [any]: any } | Object | userdata, metamethodName: string, hook: (...any) -> (...any)): (...any) -> (...any)

parameters.functionToRestore: The hooked function that you want to restore

restorefunction.title: restorefunction
restorefunction.description: `restorefunction` restores a hooked function back to the very first original function, even if it has been hooked multiple times.

isexecutorclosure.title: isexecutorclosure
isexecutorclosure.description: `isexecutorclosure` checks whether a given function is a closure of the executor. This also includes closures retrieved using [`getscriptclosure`](https://docs.sunc.io/Scripts/getloadedmodules) or [`loadstring`](https://docs.sunc.io/Closures/loadstring).

clonefunction.title: clonefunction
clonefunction.description: `clonefunction` creates and returns a new function that has the exact same behaviour as the passed function.

parameters.source: The source code string to compile.

loadstring.title: loadstring
loadstring.description: `loadstring` compiles a string of Luau code and returns it as a runnable function. If the code has errors, two things are returned: `nil` and a `string`, which is the error message.
loadstring.signature: function loadstring<A...>(source: string, chunkname: string?): (((A...) -> any) | nil, string?)

parameters.functionToHook: The function that will be hooked
parameters.hook: The function that will be used as a hook

hookfunction.title: hookfunction
hookfunction.description: `hookfunction` allows you to hook a function with another wanted function, returning the original unhooked function.
hookfunction.signature: function hookfunction<A1..., R1..., A2..., R2...>(functionToHook: (A1...) -> R1..., hook: (A2...) -> R2...): (A1...) -> R1...

islclosure.title: islclosure
islclosure.description: `islclosure` checks whether a given function is a Luau closure or not.

parameters.functionToHash: The function to retrieve the hash of.

getfunctionhash.title: getfunctionhash
getfunctionhash.description: `getfunctionhash` returns the ***hex-represented*** [SHA384 hash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2) of a provided function's instructions (code) and constants.

checkcaller.title: checkcaller
checkcaller.description: `checkcaller` returns a boolean indicating whether the **current function was invoked from the executor's own thread**. This is useful for differentiating between your own calls and those made by the game.

parameters.property_name: The name of the property to access.

gethiddenproperty.title: gethiddenproperty
gethiddenproperty.description: `gethiddenproperty` retrieves the value of a hidden or non-scriptable property (e.g. `BinaryString`, `SharedString`, `SystemAddress`) from a given [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object), even if it would normally throw an error when accessed directly.
gethiddenproperty.signature: function gethiddenproperty(object: Object, property_name: string): (any, boolean)

Reflection._description: The **Reflection** library allows access to and manipulation of hidden or non-scriptable properties of [Objects](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object) and internal execution context. It is primarily used to bypass standard Luau restrictions in controlled environments.

getthreadidentity.title: getthreadidentity
getthreadidentity.description: `getthreadidentity` retrieves the thread's identity of the running [Luau thread](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/libraries/coroutine#running).

parameters.object: The [Object](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object) that owns the target property.
parameters.property_value: The new value to assign to the property.
parameters.property_name: The name of the property to update.

sethiddenproperty.title: sethiddenproperty
sethiddenproperty.description: `sethiddenproperty` assigns a value to a hidden or non-scriptable property of an [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object), even if that property is inaccessible.
sethiddenproperty.signature: function sethiddenproperty(object: Object, property_name: string, property_value: any): boolean

parameters.object: The [Object](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object) that owns the target property.
parameters.state: Whether to enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) scriptability.
parameters.property_name: The name of the property to make scriptable or un-scriptable.

setscriptable.title: setscriptable
setscriptable.description: `setscriptable` toggles the scriptability of a hidden or non-scriptable property on an [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object). When a property is made scriptable, it can be accessed or assigned through standard indexing.
setscriptable.signature: function setscriptable(object: Object, property_name: string, state: boolean): boolean | nil

parameters.id: The identity level to set the current thread to.

setthreadidentity.title: setthreadidentity
setthreadidentity.description: `setthreadidentity` sets the current [Luau thread](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/libraries/coroutine#running) identity and capabilities matching that identity.

parameters.object: The [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object) that owns the target property.
parameters.property: The name of the property to check.

isscriptable.title: isscriptable
isscriptable.description: `isscriptable` returns whether the given property of an [`Object`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Object) is scriptable (i.e. it does not have the `notscriptable` tag).
isscriptable.signature: function isscriptable(object: Object, property: string): boolean | nil

parameters.options: A table of fields defining the HTTP request.

request.title: request
request.description: `request` sends a [HTTP request](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTP) to the given URL using the provided configuration table. It yields until the request is complete and returns a structured response.

Miscellaneous._description: The **Miscellaneous** library contains functions that do not belong to a specific category.

identifyexecutor.title: identifyexecutor
identifyexecutor.description: `identifyexecutor` returns the name and version of the currently running executor.

lz4decompress.title: lz4decompress
lz4decompress.description: `lz4decompress` decompresses a string that was encoded using the [LZ4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LZ4_(compression_algorithm)) compression algorithm back to regular data.

Encoding._description:
The **Encoding** library provides functions for common binary transformation operations such as Base64 and LZ4 - the **encoding**, **decoding**, **compression**, and **decompression** of data.
This library replaces the old `crypt` library, which has now been fully deprecated.

lz4compress.title: lz4compress
lz4compress.description: `lz4compress` compresses a string with the [LZ4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LZ4_(compression_algorithm)) compression algorithm.

base64decode.title: base64decode
base64decode.description: `base64decode` decodes a [Base64-encoded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Base64) string back into its original form.

parameters.signal: The signal to inspect for active connections.

getconnections.title: getconnections
getconnections.description: `getconnections` retrieves a list of [`Connection`](https://docs.sunc.io/Signals/Connection) objects currently attached to a given [`RBXScriptSignal`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptSignal).

Signals._description: The **Signals** library provides functions for inspecting and manipulating [`RBXScriptSignal`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptSignal) and [`RBXScriptConnection`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptConnection) objects.

parameters.signal: The signal whose connections you want to manually fire.
parameters....?: The arguments to pass to the connected functions.

firesignal.title: firesignal
firesignal.description: `firesignal` Invokes all Luau [connections](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptConnection) connected to a given [`RBXScriptSignal`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptSignal).

parameters.signal: The signal to replicate to the server.
parameters....?: Arguments to pass to the signal.

replicatesignal.title: replicatesignal
replicatesignal.description: `replicatesignal` replicates a signal to the server with the provided arguments, if possible. The arguments must also match accordingly to the signal itself. To know a signal's arguments, visit [this](https://robloxapi.github.io/ref/).
